document.name: High Bridge Library NYPL After School
document.shortDescription: Free Highbridge library drop-in for ages 6-12 with homework help, reading support, STEAM activities, and snacks after school.
document.longDescription:
The New York Public Library's High Bridge branch lists NYPL After School as a free drop-in program for kids ages 6-12. The official branch page says the program takes place after regular school hours on Mondays through Thursdays when school is in session, with homework help from tutors or Teen Reading Ambassadors, reading recommendations, fun activities, and snacks.

A current official NYPL After School event listing for High Bridge Library shows the program running from 3:30 PM to 6:30 PM and repeating across upcoming Monday-Thursday dates. Families do not need to register in advance.

The branch page lists High Bridge Library at 78 West 168th Street, Bronx, NY 10452, with phone 718-293-7800 and email highbridge@nypl.org.

Sources: https://www.nypl.org/locations/high-bridge https://www.nypl.org/events/programs/2026/03/02/nypl-after-school-3
